questions.question: In ΔABC, D is a point on AC such that AB = BD = DC, if ∠BAD = 70°, then the measure of ∠B is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2fca8cbba9c8540730f1789bb3d8eca414c7a61b57fc3d33b298e5ff23a0cbd.png] 

Given, AB = BD = DC

And ∠BAD = 70°

In ΔABD,

⇒ ∠BAD = ∠BDA = 70° [∵ AB = BD]

⇒ ∠ABD + ∠BAD + ∠BDA = 180°

⇒ ∠ABD = 180° – 70° – 70° = 40°

⇒ ∠BDC = 180° – ∠BDA = 180° – 70° = 110°

In ΔBDC,

⇒ ∠DBC = ∠DCB [∵ BD = DC]

⇒ ∠DBC + ∠BDC + ∠DCB = 180°

⇒ 2∠DBC = 180° – 110° = 70°

⇒ ∠DBC = 35°

⇒ ∠ABC = ∠ABD + ∠DBC = 40° + 35° = 75°

questions.question: The total production of type B cars during 2013 to 2016 is approximately what percent less than total production of cars in 2017?
questions.solution:

Total production of cars in 2017 = 64 + 66 + 72 + 66 + 62 = 330

questions.question: A train travelling at 44 km/h crosses a man walking with a speed of 8 km/h, in the same direction, in 15 seconds. If the train crosses a woman coming from the opposite direction in 10 seconds, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the woman?
questions.solution:
Speed of the train = 44 km/h & Speed of the man = 8 km/h

⇒ Length of the train = (44 – 8) × (5/18) × 15 = 150 meters

Let the speed of the woman be x km/h

According to the question

⇒ (44 + x) × 5/18 = 150/10

⇒ (44 + x) = 54

⇒ x = 10 km/h

In a circle with center O and radius 10 cm, PQ and RS are two parallel chords of lengths x cm and 12 cm, respectively, and both the chords are on the opposite side of O. If the distance between PQ and RS is 14 cm, the value of x is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48ad31515fd6ef073c36eb1b54111c26d56b15cc83b9e004fcf402c177c1f53b.png] 

In ΔORN,

⇒ RS = 12 cm and RN = 6 cm and OR = 10 cm

By using Pythagoras Theorem

⇒ (OR)² = (ON)² + (RN)²

⇒ 10² = (ON)² + 6²

⇒ ON = 8 cm

⇒ NM = 14 cm

⇒ OM = NM – ON = 14 – 8 = 6 cm

In ΔPMO

By using Pythagoras Theorem

⇒ (OP)² = (OM)² + (MP)²

⇒ 10² = (6)² + (x/2)² [∵ PQ = x cm, ∴ MP = x/2 cm]

⇒ x/2 = 8

⇒ x = 16 cm

questions.question: If a + b + c = 2, a² + b² + c² = 26, then the value of a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc is:
questions.solution:
a + b + c = 2, a² + b² + c² = 26

AS we know,

⇒ (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 2² = 26 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ ab + bc + ca = -11

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c) [(a + b + c)² – 3(ab + bc + ca)]

⇒ 2[2² – 3 × (-11)]

⇒ 2[4 + 33]

⇒ 74

questions.question: The average of eleven numbers is 54. The average of the first four numbers is 48 and that of the next four numbers is 25% more than the average of the first four. The ninth number is 8 greater than the 11thnumber and the tenth number is 4 greater than the 11th number. What is the average of the 9th and the 10thnumbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 11 numbers = 54

Sum of 11 numbers = 54 × 11 = 594

Average of the first four numbers = 48

Sum of the first four number = 48 × 4 = 192

Average of the next four numbers = 48 × [5/4] = 60

Sum of the next four numbers = 60 × 4 = 240

Let the 11th number be x.

∴ 9th number be x + 8 & 10th number be x + 4

Sum of 9th, 10th and 11th numbers = 594 – 192 – 240 = 162

According to the question

⇒ x + 8 + x + 4 + x = 162

⇒ 3x = 162 – 12

⇒ x = 50

⇒ 9th number = x + 8 = 50 + 8 = 58

⇒ 10th number = x + 4 = 50 + 4 = 54

∴ Average of 9th and 10th number = (58 + 54)/2 = 56

questions.question: Some fruits are bought at a rate of 11 for Rs. 100 and an equal number at a rate of 9 for Rs. 100. If all the fruits are sold at a rate of 10 for Rs. 100, then what is the gain or loss percent in the entire transaction?
questions.solution:
Suppose 99 fruits are bought at a rate of 11 for Rs 100, then cost of 99 fruits = 9 × 100 = Rs. 900

99 fruits are also bought at a rate of 9 for Rs 100, then cost of 99 fruits = 11 × 100 = Rs 1100

Total cost of 198 fruits = 900 + 1100 = Rs. 2000

SP of 10 fruits = Rs. 100

SP of 1 fruit = Rs. 10

SP of 198 fruits = Rs. 1980

⇒ Total loss = 2000 – 1980 = Rs. 20

∴ Required loss percentage = [20/2000] × 100 = 1%

questions.question: Sudha saves 15% of her income. If her expenditure increases by 20% and savings increase by 60%, then by what percent has her income increased?
questions.solution:
Let income of Sudha be 200x

Saving of Sudha = 200x × [15/100] = 30x

Expenditure of Sudha = 200x – 30x = 170x

New Expenditure of Sudha = 170x × [6/5] = 204x

New Savings of Sudha = 30x × [8/5] = 48x

New income of Sudha = 204x + 48x = 252x

New income increased by = 252x – 200x = 52x

∴ Required percentage = [52x/200x] × 100 = 26%

questions.question: To do a certain work, the ratio of the efficiencies of A, B and C is 7 : 5 : 6. Working together, they can complete the same work in 35 days. B and C work together for 21 days. The remaining work will be completed by A alone in:
questions.solution:
Efficiency ratio of A, B and C = 7 : 5 : 6

Total work = (7 + 5 + 6) × 35 = 18 × 35 = 630

Completed work by B and C in 21 days = (5 + 6) × 21 = 231

⇒ Remaining work = 630 – 231 = 399

∴ A will complete the remaining work in = 399/7 = 57 days
